l.i: Vm primum mihi candida Neæra Illos sideribus pares ocellos Ostendisti ocelluli miselli, Illa principium fuit malorum, Illa lux animi ruina nostri, Sic primis radijs repente tactus Totus intremui cohorruique, Vt leues nemorum come virentium Primis flatibus intremunt Fauoni, Et cor iam meditans ad illam abire Per pectus trepidánsque palpitánsque Iámque euadere, iámque gestiebat: Ceu solet puer artubus tenellis Quem nutrix gremio fouet, parentem Affectare oculis & ore, parua Iactans brachia: ceu solent volucres Adhuc inuolucres volandi inani Infirmas studio monere pennas: Tu mens prouida, virtum suarum Quippe

page.notes: Marginal marks at right edge (small reference marks and a few brackets) are not legible enough to transcribe as notes. The "Quippe" at lower right is treated as catchword. Title block lines are set in mixed capitals and italic; the ornamental initial "V" is a woodcut letter joined to "Vm". Some words in the verse are uncertain due to scan quality.
